patches.needle: registry[1672]={name:'恶鬼·图伽',sourceHash:'4254ff4c',partial:true,unimplemented:['Q-N20-4459-001：两弱化异常混合成功时未触发吸取范围'],traits:{},hooks:{roundStart(c){c.a.soulState.tugaStartAilments=conditionStatusRules.conditionPresent(c.t,c.round)?Object.values(c.t.ailments).filter(end=>end>=c.round).length:0;},afterUse(c){const n=c.a.soulState.tugaStartAilments??0;if(c.a.hp>0&&c.m.kind!=='item'&&n>0)healthRules.drainFixed(c,n*100,'恶鬼回合初异常种数吸取');},combatEnd(c){if(c.a.hp<=0||c.t.hp<=0)return;const names=soulStatusPools.pool(undefined,{includeRestricted:true}).map(x=>x.name).filter(conditionStatusRules.isWeakening),result=c.randomAilmentsFrom(2,names,null),success=result.filter(x=>x.applied).length;if(success===0)healthRules.drainPercent(c,c.t.stats.maxHp/3,'恶鬼双异常未触发吸取');else if(success!==result.length)c.a.soulState.pendingTugaMixedStatuses={question:'Q-N20-4459-001',round:c.round,result};}}};
